answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded collateral escrows: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling quadratically, O(k^2), rather than treating each identity independently. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, so splitting control across a swarm magnifies the stake destroyed instead of diluting risk. The orchard, nebula, and ivory labels do not alter linkage: shared coordination remains costly to conceal.
